title: [ingest] Cluster duplicate notes at 0.80 recall
summary: Duplicate clustering uses a hard recall threshold of 0.80 and then caps large connected components so results stay tractable. That makes dedupe behavior deterministic and prevents one giant blob from hiding actionable clusters.
